name: Dr. Ahmad Rizal
story: As a surgeon, I see the immediate need for care. This ride is my way of ensuring every child gets their chance at health.

name: Sarah Chen
story: Endurance is more than just miles; it's the heart to keep going for those who can't.

name: Lt. Murali Kumar
story: Service never ends. Today, I serve the children of Malaysia through the pedals of my bike.

name: Rider 4
story: Since joining the Sepeda Amal movement, my perspective on endurance has shifted. We're not just pushing pedals; we're pushing for a future where every child in Malaysia has access to the paediatric care they deserve.
